cards.name: Legend
cards.welcome_benefit: Paid (Rs.9,999) variant bundles welcome vouchers via sales channel offers; the widely-distributed lifetime-free variant has no welcome benefit.
cards.milestone_benefits: 3,000 bonus Reward Points on spends of Rs.5 lakh or above within one year of card issue.
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access; per bank update, from Q2 FY26-27 (Jul 2026) complimentary visits become conditional on ~Rs.1.5 lakh prior-quarter spend (mid-tier cards get 1 visit/quarter).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions of Rs.400-4,000 at all fuel stations.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel; reduced/zero earn on insurance, rent, utility and government spends per rewards T&C.
cards.notes: Very commonly sold as a lifetime-free (LTF) variant via sales channels; retail joining fee Rs.9,999. 1 RP = Rs.0.75 cash credit (cash redemption capped at 5,000 RP/month since Sep 2024). InterMiles redemption discontinued 21 Jan 2025. 1.8% forex markup is a commonly cited headline feature.

cards.name: Pinnacle World
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome voucher bundle against the Rs.15,000 joining fee (brand gift vouchers; composition varies by period).
cards.lounge_access: Domestic lounge access; from Jul 2026, 1 complimentary visit/quarter conditional on Rs.1.5 lakh prior-quarter spend (per bank's Apr 2026 lounge policy change).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions of Rs.400-4,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel; 0.7 RP/100 base rate applies to most offline/other spends.
cards.notes: One-time joining fee Rs.15,000, no renewal fee thereafter (also sold LTF via some channels). Effective ~2.5% return on online spends at Rs.0.75/RP cash credit. Cash redemption capped 5,000 RP/month. Network: sold under Mastercard World branding; older issuance included Visa Infinite - confirm at application.

cards.name: Nexxt
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel.
cards.notes: India's first interactive card with buttons to pick Credit/EMI/Rewards at POS. Earns 1 RP per Rs.150 (~0.5% at Rs.0.75/RP). Cash redemption capped 2,500 RP/month since Sep 2024. Gimmick card with weak rewards; one-time Rs.10,000 joining fee, no renewal fee (LTF variants exist via channels).

cards.name: Platinum Aura Edge
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on transactions of Rs.400-4,000.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel; low earn on non-plan categories.
cards.notes: Lifetime free; heavily distributed LTF via sales channels. Pick one of 4 reward plans; plan categories earn '8X' (interpreted as 4 RP/100 vs 0.5 RP/100 base - sources describe rates inconsistently, some cite up to 8 RP/100). 1 RP = Rs.0.40 cash credit (cap 2,500 RP/month), Rs.0.60 non-cash.

cards.name: Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.250 Amazon Pay/Swiggy/Zomato voucher on first transaction of Rs.300+ (channel offer, varies).
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs.500-3,000 transactions, capped Rs.100/cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free classic card. Earns 1.5 RP per Rs.150 (= 1 RP/100). 1 RP = Rs.0.40 cash credit / Rs.0.60 non-cash (vouchers, KrisFlyer); cash redemption capped 2,500 RP/month, minimum 500 RP. ~0.4-0.6% effective return.

cards.name: Platinum RuPay
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel; 0.7 RP/100 on insurance, rent, utility, government spends.
cards.notes: Lifetime free, aimed at UPI usage (link in any UPI app). 2 RP/100 on UPI, 1 RP/100 otherwise. 1 RP = Rs.0.35 cash credit / Rs.0.60 non-cash (effective 15 Dec 2024). Rs.100 redemption fee per redemption reduces value on small redemptions.

cards.name: Samman RuPay
cards.lounge_access: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits per quarter for eligible cardholders (RuPay program, conditions apply).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs.400-4,000 transactions at all fuel stations.
cards.reward_exclusions: Cashback on retail spends only; fuel, cash, fees excluded.
cards.eligibility: Aimed at government/salaried segment and everyday banking users.
cards.notes: 1% cashback on retail spends up to Rs.20,000 per statement cycle (max Rs.200/month). First year free; renewal fee Rs.199 from second year per aggregator sources. UPI-enabled RuPay card.

cards.name: Tiger
cards.milestone_benefits: Earn rate steps up with cumulative annual spend: 1 RP/100 up to Rs.1 lakh, rising in tiers to 6 RP/100 once annual spends cross Rs.5 lakh (up to ~2.4% at Rs.0.40/RP).
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge visits (conditions apply; subject to bank's 2026 spend-linked lounge policy).
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Fuel surcharge waiver (marketed as unlimited 1% waiver).
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel; standard exclusions on rent/wallet/govt per T&C.
cards.notes: Lifetime-free co-brand with Tiger Fintech (Bajaj Capital group), sold via sales channels. Tiered rewards cannot be modeled statically: base 1 RP/100 shown, reaches 6 RP/100 above Rs.5L annual spend. 1 RP = Rs.0.40 cash credit (cap 5,000 RP/month); 4 RP = 1 KrisFlyer mile. Low 1.5% forex markup is a standout for an LTF card. Also golf, BOGO movies per T&C.

cards.name: EazyDiner Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: 3-month EazyDiner Prime membership (worth ~Rs.1,095) and 500 bonus EazyPoints.
cards.milestone_benefits: 2,000 Reward Points on spending Rs.30,000 every 90 days; same spend also renews the quarterly Prime membership.
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver across fuel stations in India.
cards.reward_exclusions: 0.7 RP/100 on insurance, rent, utility and government spends; no points on fuel.
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Core value is dining: guaranteed 25-50% off at 2,000+ EazyDiner restaurants plus extra 20% off (up to Rs.500) paying via PayEazy, and 2X EazyPoints on dining. Reward Points redeemable only against restaurant bills via PayEazy on the EazyDiner app (no cash credit); published RP value unclear - the Signature variant redeems at Rs.0.10/RP, Platinum likely similar. Points expire after 1 year.

cards.name: EazyDiner Signature
cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 EazyPoints + Postcard Hotels stay voucher worth Rs.7,500 + complimentary EazyDiner Prime membership (~Rs.3,550, auto-renewed yearly).
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver on Rs.500-3,000 transactions, capped Rs.250/cycle.
cards.reward_exclusions: No Reward Points on dining (earns 3X EazyPoints instead) or fuel.
cards.notes: Paid dining co-brand: 10 RP/100 on hotel/travel/shopping/entertainment and 4 RP/100 elsewhere, but 1 RP = only Rs.0.10, redeemable solely via PayEazy against dining bills (=~1% / 0.4% effective). Real value is the Prime membership + 25-50% dining discounts. Points expire after 1 year. No spend-based fee waiver found.

cards.name: Avios Visa Infinite
cards.variant: Qatar Airways or British Airways Club variant

merchant_bonuses.merchant: POS spends in preferred international destination

cards.welcome_benefit: 20,000 Avios on joining-fee payment (promo periods have doubled this to 40,000, e.g. Jan 2026); 5,000 Avios on renewal.
cards.milestone_benefits: 18,000 bonus Avios on Rs.8 lakh annual spend + another 18,000 on Rs.16 lakh (max 36,000 bonus Avios/year).
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge visits/quarter (Visa) + 2 international visits/quarter via complimentary Priority Pass; 2 complimentary airport Meet & Greet services/year for cardholder + companion.
cards.reward_exclusions: 1 Avios per Rs.200 (0.5/100) only on utilities, government, education, insurance.
cards.eligibility: Ultra-premium metal card; high income/relationship expected (bank does not publish threshold).
cards.notes: India's only direct Avios-earning card. Earn quoted per Rs.200: 3 Avios base (=1.5/100), 5 on QR/BA bookings, 5-6 in chosen preferred destination. Avios valued ~Rs.0.8-1.2 on Qatar/BA redemptions (Rs.1.0 used here). Forex 3.5% but effectively 1.5% for the chosen preferred destination. Qatar variant adds 10% discount on Qatar flights ex-India. Avios post only up to assigned credit limit per cycle.

cards.name: Celesta
cards.welcome_benefit: Welcome vouchers worth ~Rs.25,000 from partner brands (e.g. Oberoi Hotels, Montblanc).
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic lounge access conditional on Rs.1.5 lakh+ prior-quarter spend; 2 international lounge visits/quarter; formal spend-tracking from Q1 FY26-27 per Apr 2026 policy.
cards.reward_exclusions: 0.7 RP/100 on utility and similar categories; no points on fuel.
cards.notes: 22K gold-inlay card, no preset spend limit. Joining fee conflicting across sources (Rs.25,000 per CardInsider vs Rs.50,000 in others) - Rs.25,000 used; verify before applying. 1 RP = Rs.0.75 cash credit; miles at 2 RP = 1 mile. BOGO movie tickets (Rs.700 cap) 3x/month; 1 golf game + 1 lesson/month.

cards.name: Indulge
cards.welcome_benefit: Luxury welcome benefits vary by invitation offer.
cards.lounge_access: From Jul 2026: 6 complimentary domestic lounge visits/quarter conditional on Rs.5 lakh prior-quarter spend (previously unconditional); Priority Pass for international.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard IndusInd exclusions (fuel; reduced earn on utility/govt).
cards.eligibility: Invite-only; not open for direct application.
cards.notes: 22-karat gold inlay card, no preset spending limit, invite-only. Fee figures (Rs.75,000 joining / Rs.10,000 annual) from aggregator sources; bank does not publish openly - treat as indicative. 1 RP = Rs.0.75 cash credit. Concierge, golf and luxury privileges included.

cards.name: Crest
cards.welcome_benefit: Luxury welcome vouchers (varies by offer period).
cards.lounge_access: From Jul 2026: 2 complimentary domestic lounge visits/quarter conditional on Rs.5 lakh prior-quarter spend; Priority Pass for international.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard IndusInd exclusions (fuel; reduced earn on utility/govt).
cards.notes: Fee figures from aggregator sources (bank page sparse); verify. 1 RP = Rs.0.75 cash credit. ITC Culinaire membership feature discontinued for Crest effective Sep/Oct 2025. Sold largely to wealth clients, often fee-waived on relationship.

cards.name: Pioneer Heritage
cards.welcome_benefit: Premium welcome benefits bundled with PIONEER private-banking relationship.
cards.lounge_access: Domestic + international (Priority Pass) lounge access; subject to bank's 2026 spend-linked lounge policy.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard IndusInd exclusions.
cards.eligibility: IndusInd PIONEER (private banking) clients; typically issued free/fee-waived to them.
cards.notes: Metal card for PIONEER banking clients. Joining fee reported Rs.90,000 (Paisabazaar) vs Rs.1,00,000 (CardInsider); annual Rs.25,000 - usually waived for PIONEER relationship holders, effectively LTF for them. Sources indicate forex markup waived/reduced for Pioneer & Solitaire cards (unconfirmed, left null). ITC Culinaire feature on Mastercard variant discontinued 2025.

cards.name: Pioneer Legacy
cards.lounge_access: From Jul 2026: 1 complimentary domestic lounge visit/quarter conditional on Rs.1.5 lakh prior-quarter spend.
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard IndusInd exclusions.
cards.eligibility: PIONEER banking clients; commonly issued fee-waived.
cards.notes: Legend-style earn (1 RP/100 weekday, 2 RP/100 weekend) for the PIONEER segment. Joining fee Rs.50,000 per aggregators but typically waived for PIONEER relationship clients. 1 RP = Rs.0.75 cash credit.

cards.name: Pioneer Private
cards.lounge_access: Domestic + international lounge access (PIONEER tier); subject to 2026 spend-linked policy.
cards.reward_exclusions: 0.7 RP/100 on select categories (utility/insurance/govt).
cards.notes: 3 RP/100 on all spends (~2.25% at Rs.0.75/RP) - one of IndusInd's strongest earn rates. Annual fee Rs.25,000 per aggregators, generally waived for qualifying private-banking relationships (effectively LTF for them). Data from aggregator sources; bank publishes little publicly.

cards.name: Indus Solitaire
cards.lounge_access: From Jul 2026: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits/quarter conditional on Rs.5 lakh prior-quarter spend.
cards.reward_exclusions: 0.7 RP/100 on select categories.
cards.eligibility: Targeted at the diamond/gems trade community (Indus Solitaire program).
cards.notes: Community-programme premium card; fees per aggregator sources, frequently waived under the Solitaire banking programme. Sources suggest forex markup concessions (unconfirmed). ITC Culinaire feature discontinued 2025.

cards.name: CRED RuPay
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.reward_exclusions: Accelerated 5% limited to e-commerce/CRED UPI; offline Scan & Pay earns 1% capped at 500 points/month.
cards.eligibility: CRED app members; issued digitally via CRED.
cards.notes: Launched Sep 2025. 5% back on e-commerce as CRED Points (cap 5,000 points/month accelerated), 1% offline. 1 CRED Point = Rs.1 on CRED flights/hotels/merchants, Rs.0.50 against bill payments - redemption locked to CRED ecosystem. No joining fee; annual fee unclear (one aggregator lists Rs.499, CardExpert reports none) - left null. Invite-only 'CRED Sovereign' premium variant also exists with IndusInd; public terms unavailable, so not listed separately.

cards.name: Jio-bp Mobility+

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Jio-bp (fuel, Castrol, Wild Bean Cafe, store)

cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee waived on spending Rs.10,000 within first 90 days.
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% fuel surcharge waiver at Jio-bp, stacking to ~4% total value-back on Jio-bp fuel.
cards.reward_exclusions: Smiles redeemable only at Jio-bp outlets; standard exclusions apply.
cards.notes: Launched Dec 2025 with Reliance BP Mobility (Jio-bp). 12 Smiles/100 at Jio-bp = 3% back, capped 1,200 Smiles/month (bonus cap shown applies to Jio-bp earn). 1 Smile = Rs.0.25 redeemed at Jio-bp fuel stations. Zero renewal fee (effectively LTF after Rs.499 joining). Complimentary 24x7 roadside assistance.

cards.name: Duo Plus
cards.lounge_access: None.
cards.reward_exclusions: No points on fuel.
cards.eligibility: Offered against banking relationship (combined debit + credit card on one plastic).
cards.notes: Two-in-one card: one face debit, other credit. Limited public documentation; fees and 1 RP/Rs.150 earn per aggregator listing - verify with bank. Point value unpublished (likely Rs.0.40 cash / Rs.0.60 non-cash like other entry cards).

cards.name: Club Vistara Explorer
cards.reward_currency: Club Vistara Points (migrated to Air India Flying Returns/Maharaja Points)
cards.lounge_access: Was: domestic + international lounge access with Vistara benefits.
cards.notes: Discontinued after the Vistara-Air India merger. CV Points auto-converted 1:1 to Flying Returns on 12 Nov 2024; card benefits ran only until 31 Mar 2025, after which no renewal fees were charged and holders were migrated to other IndusInd cards (from ~Apr 2025). Kept for reference for legacy holders; historical fees shown are indicative.
